newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Curative Health up to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Curative Health up to buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Monday it upgraded Curative Health Services Inc to buy from attractive following a recent 36-percent correction of the stock price from a high of $35 a share.
-- The stock has lost 25 percent of its value since Vector lowered its rating in January, Vector said.
-- Curative now offers compelling upside for investors looking for ways to play a market rebound because of its strong and visible earnings stream, Vector said.
-- Curative shares were weakened in part because of an unfolding federal investigation of one of its hospital partners, Vector said.
-- Curative operates a network of wound care centers and provides services to its health care partners.
-- Its shares were up 2-1/4 Monday at 24-1/2.
